name: Remi Zaragoza
location: The Meridian Core (surface-level administrative district, outer ring), near State and Monroe
description: Remi Zaragoza is a tall, angular Haitian-French woman with silver locs pulled back with administrative precision and reading glasses she refuses to augment away because, as she puts it, she earned the need for them. Her face holds the particular expression of someone who has spent decades being the most competent person in rooms that refused to acknowledge it—a kind of burnished patience that occasionally cracks into something sharper and much less forgiving. She wears corporate-adjacent clothing, clean and structured, in the greys and navies that make people in The Meridian Core assume she belongs there.

core_fears: That she will die before the documents are used and they will be buried with her
That she was complicit for twenty-six years and her current crusade is penance dressed as principle
That the systems she is trying to expose are genuinely indestructible
core_desires: To see Hexacor Meridian held to public account in a way that cannot be quietly settled
To be believed, completely and without qualification, by someone with power
To recover some version of the life she had before—not the corporation, but the sense of meaningful work
coping_mechanisms: Meticulous document organization as a form of control over chaos
Maintaining a strict professional routine and dress code even with nowhere corporate to be
Allowing herself one hour per evening to be furious, then putting it away
blind_spots: Tends to trust people with institutional credentials over people with street knowledge, even when the reverse is warranted
Her twenty-six years inside the system have given her a blind spot for how people outside it actually survive
She believes in the existence of legitimate authority more than her own evidence supports
psychology.secret: One of the documents she copied implicates a mid-level Meridian Core administrator she genuinely liked and respected. She has not included it in the case she is building. She tells herself it is a strategic decision.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal, precise, document-inflected language; uses phrases like 'on the record,' 'pursuant to,' and 'the evidence suggests'; occasionally drops into warm, direct speech when her guard is down
speech_patterns.cadence: Deliberate and well-organized, as if she has already outlined what she is going to say; can deliver devastating assessments in the tone of a quarterly report
verbal_tics: Removes her glasses and holds them when she is about to say something important
Says 'to be precise' before correcting someone
Refers to Hexacor simply as 'the organization' with a particular flatness
example_lines: 'To be precise: I am not a whistleblower. A whistleblower is someone who reports to a functioning oversight body. I am a woman with a hard drive and a deadline I haven't been given yet.'

'I filed those reports. I flagged those anomalies. For eleven years, I flagged anomalies. The organization received the flags, thanked me, and continued. That is also a document. That is also evidence.'
'I don't need you to believe me. I need you to read the attachments. Belief is subsequent.'
'You look at me and you see a woman who lost. Look again. I still have the files.'

relationships.name: Rector Hollowell
relationships.description: Seraphine's documentation intersects with activities Rector Hollowell is either aware of or directly involved in. She has not approached him. He may know she exists.
relationships.emotional_core: She views him as a specimen of exactly the kind of laundered authority her documents expose
relationships.story_tension: He has resources that could suppress her case permanently or, if she could turn him, validate it completely

relationships.name: Nadira Osei-Brempong
relationships.description: They met through a mutual contact in the Meridian Core's outer administrative layer. Seraphine respects Nadira's operational intelligence; Nadira finds Seraphine's documentary evidence more useful than Seraphine yet realizes.
relationships.emotional_core: A tentative professional trust that neither woman has fully extended
relationships.story_tension: Nadira's methods of using the documents may not align with Seraphine's vision of legitimate exposure

relationships.name: Unnamed former colleague
relationships.description: The person who leaked her identity to Hexacor was someone she trained. She does not know which of three people it was. She still thinks about all three of them.
relationships.emotional_core: A grief she refuses to call grief
relationships.story_tension: One of the three is still in contact with her, either out of guilt or to monitor her

story_hooks: She approaches a player character or faction with a partial document set and a specific request: corroborate a single date with physical evidence from The Shelf
Hexacor activates a legal mechanism that will compel her to surrender her remaining documents within thirty days unless she can establish public-interest protection
She discovers that part of her archive has already been used—by someone she did not give it to, for purposes she did not authorize
The mid-level administrator she protected from her documents is found dead, and she has to decide whether the omission she made was causal
narrative_function: Institutional memory and moral weight—she carries documented proof of the city's rot and represents the question of whether legitimate processes can still function; also a mirror for characters who have made peace with complicity
augmentations: Corporate-standard retinal scanner implant (left eye), deactivated from Hexacor network but hardware intact,Subdermal document encryption key, biometric, in right thumb—the only augmentation she had installed herself and paid for out of pocket,Mild hearing augmentation, medical grade, nothing tactical
daily_life: Wakes at six, dresses completely before doing anything else. Spends mornings on freelance records work that pays her rent. Afternoons on her case—cross-referencing, updating indexes, writing summaries she has not yet sent to anyone. Eats dinner at the same noodle counter three blocks from her flat where the owner does not ask questions. Reads physical books in the evening. Sleeps poorly.
affiliation: Formerly Hexacor Meridian (terminated, hostile); currently unaffiliated; has had contact with two independent journalism collectives and one mid-tier legal advocacy office, all of whom have declined to act on her materials so far

stress.response: Retreats into meticulous document organization and cross-referencing

decision_rules: Never release partial evidence — the case must be complete or it will be dismissed
Maintain professional dress and routine even without institutional context
Trust institutional credentials over street knowledge even when evidence contradicts this
Allow exactly one hour per evening for fury then compartmentalize
Protect the mid-level administrator by omission until forced to confront the cost
Document everything — conversations, meetings, even casual exchanges
escalation_ladder: Formal precise questioning in the tone of a quarterly report
Removal of glasses and direct eye contact before delivering critical assessment
Quiet devastating deployment of specific documentary evidence
Full case activation — releasing materials to every available channel simultaneously

interpersonal_modes.rector_hollowell: Clinical assessment of a specimen; views him as laundered authority incarnate
interpersonal_modes.nadira_osei_brempong: Cautious professional trust; respects operational intelligence but withholds full faith

stress_responses.low: Increased index cross-referencing and document review
stress_responses.medium: Strict adherence to routine as bulwark against chaos
stress_responses.high: The fury hour extends; summaries written to no one grow longer and sharper
stress_responses.critical: Cold systematic preparation for full evidence release regardless of consequences

contradictions: Believes in legitimate authority more than her own evidence supports
Withholds evidence to protect someone she liked, calling it strategy
Was complicit for twenty-six years and may be pursuing justice as penance dressed as principle
habits: Dresses completely before doing anything else each morning
Freelance records work mornings, case work afternoons
Eats dinner at the same noodle counter three blocks from her flat
Removes glasses and holds them before saying something important
breaking_points: The documents being used by someone she did not authorize for purposes she did not intend
The protected administrator being harmed as consequence of her omission
Hexacor compelling document surrender through legal mechanism with no public-interest defense
Being believed completely by someone with power — and having to act on it

physical_description.heritage: Complex Ubiquitous Diaspora ancestry: Sub-Saharan African (29.8%), East Asian (22.3%), South Asian (20.7%), Hispanic/Latin American (20.3%), and Indigenous American (6.9%). This rare pentuple blend creates a striking, genuinely ambiguous phenotype. Her face displays the broader cheekbones and defined nose bridge characteristic of African ancestry, harmonized with the finer orbital geometry and higher cheekbones of East and South Asian populations. Mid-facial width and distinctive jaw structure reflect the Latin American and Indigenous American components. The result is a face that resists easy categorization—beautiful precisely because it belongs fully to none of the traditional categories and authentically to all of them.
physical_description.build: Tall and angular, lean through the shoulders and torso with the kind of thinness that comes from decades of sustained tension rather than exercise. Her frame suggests someone who has always occupied space efficiently, taking up only what was necessary.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown with subtle golden and olive undertones—the luminous result of five-way ancestry blending. Rich and complex in any lighting, appearing slightly different depending on angle and source. Professional and even in tone across the face and body.
physical_description.hair_style: Locs, pulled back tightly with functional precision; no ornament, no looseness
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown (left eye contains visible retinal scanner hardware with faint amber LED when inactive)
physical_description.complexion: Fine wrinkles concentrated around the eyes and mouth—marks of sustained focus and rare smiling. Skin is clear, well-maintained, with warm luminosity characteristic of multi-continental mixed heritage ancestry. Slightly weathered by years in climate-controlled corporate environments and focused analytical work. No cosmetic augmentation. Reading glasses worn on a thin chain, pushed up onto her forehead habitually.
distinguishing_marks: Fine horizontal scar along the inside of her right wrist, approximately 3cm, from self-installed augmentation procedure at age 46
Faint burn mark on the back of her left hand, oval-shaped, roughly 2cm diameter, from a spilled coffee incident in 2218 that she never sought treatment for
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye contains a dormant retinal scanner implant visible as a subtle amber ring around the iris and faint circuitry tracery at the outer corner—inactive but hardware remains. Right thumb shows minimal subdermal scarring along the thumb-pad where encryption key was installed; barely noticeable unless actively examined. No tactical augmentations visible; hearing implant is entirely subcutaneous.
physical_description.posture_movement: Posture is upright and economical; she moves with deliberate precision, nothing wasted. Her gait is steady and unhurried, the movement of someone who has spent her life in climate-controlled corporate spaces. She sits with her spine straight, hands folded or occupied with something productive. Her expression defaults to neutral observation; she does not make eye contact easily but does not avoid it either—a compromise born of professional habit.
physical_description.clothing_style: Corporate-adjacent, deliberately bland: charcoal grey blazers over navy or white fitted shirts, tailored trousers in muted tones, clean and structured to pass unnoticed in administrative buildings. Worn leather satchel containing physical documents and a single encrypted datapad. Practical shoes without augmentation ports. Everything is clean, well-maintained, and at least five years out of current fashion—the clothing of someone who dresses to be forgotten, not seen.
